newsitem.title: USA: Seven bidders line up for Stockpile nickel.
newsitem.headline: Seven bidders line up for Stockpile nickel.

text.p: Seven companies lined up to buy nickel from the U.S. Stockpile.
Abbey Metal bid for 40,000 lb at $3.1613 a lb.
BenMet bid for three lots of 160,000 lb at $3.208, $3.198 and $3.193 a lb respectively.
Keywell bid for two lots of 80,000 lb at $3.2315 and $3.1941 a lb respectively.
Allied Deals bid for two lots of 40,000 lb at $3.2074 and $3.2024 a lb respectively.
National Nickel Alloy bid for 40,000 lb at $3.10.
Phoenixx International bid for 500,000 lb at $3.20 a lb.
Thalheimer Brothers bid for 40,000 lb at $3.216.
